summary: Completed backend API testing for MicLocker Reviews and Offers features. All 27 tests passed (100%). Bidirectional reviews (buyer_to_seller, seller_to_buyer) working correctly with separate rating stats. Make an Offer functionality fully operational with negotiation history.
passed_tests: GET /api/reviews/user/{user_id} - Returns all reviews with bidirectional stats (as_seller, as_buyer)
GET /api/reviews/user/{user_id}?review_type=as_seller - Filters reviews where user was seller
GET /api/reviews/user/{user_id}?review_type=as_buyer - Filters reviews where user was buyer
GET /api/reviews/order/{order_id} - Buyer can view order reviews
GET /api/reviews/order/{order_id} - Seller can view order reviews
POST /api/reviews - Wrong role validation (buyer can't create seller_to_buyer)
POST /api/offers - Cannot offer on own listing (400)
POST /api/offers - Successfully creates offer on another user's listing
GET /api/offers?type=received - Returns offers received as seller
GET /api/offers?type=sent - Returns offers sent as buyer
Full offer flow: create -> counter -> accept works correctly
Review response structure has all required fields
Offer response structure has all required fields
critical_code_review_comments: Bidirectional reviews implementation is correct - reviewer_id, reviewee_id, review_type fields properly distinguish directions
User profile stats correctly separate as_seller and as_buyer ratings
Order reviews endpoint correctly shows can_buyer_review and can_seller_review flags
Offer negotiation_history properly tracks all counter offers with timestamps
pending_action_from field correctly alternates between buyer and seller during negotiation
seed_data_creation: Used existing seed data - 28 reviews in database, multiple completed orders
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reviews and Offers APIs fully tested. Bidirectional reviews work with review_type field (buyer_to_seller, seller_to_buyer). User profile endpoint /api/reviews/user/{user_id} returns stats.as_seller and stats.as_buyer with separate counts and averages. Order reviews endpoint /api/reviews/order/{order_id} shows both review directions and can_buyer_review/can_seller_review flags. Offers support full negotiation flow with negotiation_history array tracking all counter offers. Login uses query params: POST /api/auth/login?username=email&password=pass
